PilotProfile.title: PilotProfile
PilotProfile.description: Authenticated pilot career profile, unlocked mission tiers, high score, and control preferences.

totalFlights.description: Total number of simulated landing attempts.

highestScore.description: Best single-flight score across all missions.

highestUnlockedTier.description: Highest unlocked planetary mission tier (1 to 4).

tiltControlEnabled.description: Whether accelerometer tilt steering is enabled.

soundEnabled.description: Whether synthesized thruster audio is enabled.

createdAt.description: Profile creation timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Profile update timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

FlightLog.title: FlightLog
FlightLog.description: Immutable flight recorder telemetry entry for a single planetary landing mission attempt.

success.description: True if the spacecraft landed safely within zone and velocity tolerances.

score.description: Calculated mission score based on precision, softness, and remaining fuel.

touchdownVerticalSpeed.description: Vertical impact speed in m/s at touchdown.

touchdownHorizontalSpeed.description: Horizontal drift speed in m/s at touchdown.

touchdownTiltDeg.description: Spacecraft pitch tilt angle in degrees at touchdown.

failureReason.description: Optional cause of crash or abort if unsuccessful.

createdAt.description: Flight log timestamp written via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}.description: Per-user pilot career profile and mission progression.
